description: SoT registry — every policies/ JSON file must register here. New SoT additions require manifest entry (enforced by verify-policy --check manifest-sync).
policy: Single source of truth manifest. Adding a new policies/*.json without registering here will fail manifest-sync check.

sots.description: Embedded reserved vocabulary SoT (20 terms, scope: neutral|domain)
NEVER_GATE list (8 items) with sunset metadata
External egress allowlist (deny by default, 14 blocked patterns)
Cycle 2 candidate × decision tracking matrix (11 candidates × 5-enum). Legacy rules (R1 >= 20, R2 OR) — STRICT flag false.
Cycle 3 candidate × decision tracking matrix (8 candidates × 5-enum). STRICT mode — R1~R7 + escalation policy enforced.
Defer escalation thresholds (warn@1, fail@2, prohibit@3). Prevents indefinite carry-over chains.
Cycle 4 candidate × decision tracking matrix (7 candidates × 5-enum). STRICT + escalation prohibit_at terminal cycle for CR4-1/CR4-2. CO-2 split from CR4-1 as CR4-7 adopt.
